lines.en: - Hey, listen, why don't we go change in my room?
- Chip didn't show up. - My clothes are...
- Wow, you look... - No time for that.
- Hey, dude, let me in. I got a girl out here.
- Well, I've got a girl in here.
- No, you don't. I just saw you go in there with Monica.
- Well, we're... we're hanging out in here.
- Which one of us is gonna be having sex in there,
- Well, I suppose I would have to say you.
- Look, what if we're watching a movie in here?
- Which we are, and we already paid for it.
